description: This file defines the RejectionException class within the GuzzleHttpomise namespace, representing an exception thrown when a promise is rejected. It encapsulates the rejection reason and provides methods to retrieve it.

classes.name: RejectionException
classes.description: An exception class thrown when waiting on a rejected promise, storing the rejection reason.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the RejectionException with a rejection reason and optional description, constructing an appropriate exception message.

methods.name: getReason
methods.description: Returns the stored reason for the promise rejection.
